tolerance.rationale: Declared before solve; this case verifies source-to-conduction mapping, not a full eigenvalue/feedback loop.

notes: A cosine-plus-uniform heat source is solved on three meshes against the integrated closed form; finest relative L2 profile error is 1.85e-10. The source is an analytic stand-in for a normalized eigenflux, not a live eigenvalue-to-thermal transfer, so the result is limited to the conduction coupling path.
limitations: No live T1-11 eigenvector transfer, power normalization reporter, or feedback on cross sections; fixed analytic source used.
